name: sci-paper
description: Scientific paper writing + review + ideation pipeline for top-tier journals (ApJ/MNRAS/PRD/JCAP-class). v0.11 (a) fixes the `final-review` nested-sub-agent bug — `paper-review` §4.4 isolated MPR was unrunnable when launched inside an isolation=worktree sub-agent; resolved by promoting MPR to the `final-review` main agent as a dedicated 5th isolated sub-agent (§3.6), and adding `--no-isolated-mpr` flag to `paper-review` so orchestrators can suppress the nested call. (b) adds R. Glossary consistency dimension to `paper-review` (canonical-term alignment against project FACTS.md / glossary; alias / conflict / missing detection), borrowed from mattpocock-skills:grill-with-docs. (c) adds §2.0 glossary grill prelude to `brainstorm` (one-question-at-a-time term lock against FACTS.md before root node generation). (d) rewrites 6 skill descriptions with explicit "Use when …" triggers per mattpocock-skills:write-a-skill convention. v0.10 final-review 5-skill orchestrator + paper-review P+Q dimensions, v0.9 paper-attack-tree, v0.8 mainline, v0.7 paper-review N+O, v0.6 paper-review v3 K+L+M + isolated MPR, v0.5 brainstorm carry over.
